title: Machine-Certified Formalization of the 24-Dimensional Niemeier Lattice A_8^3, K3 Hodge Duality and Umbral Moonshine
description: Formal specification and exact machine verification of the 24-dimensional even unimodular Niemeier lattice A_8^3, its ternary glue code of order 27, du Val A_8 singularity resolutions on complex K3 surfaces, and Umbral Moonshine lambency l = 9. Includes a complete Lean 4 formal specification and an exact Python algebraic verification oracle confirming 216 roots, Coxeter number h = 9, unimodularity det(N) = 1, and even integer glue norms ||g||^2 = 4 with zero defects. Formulated in direct response to the K3 Hodge cycle retractions in the openai/math repository.
